description: A parenthesized object attribute name in a type is an error
notes: The README requires attribute names to be valid identifiers and builds the extension on hcl.ExprAsKeyword and hcl.ExprCall. In an object key the native syntax spec gives parentheses a meaning beyond grouping ({(foo) = "baz"} takes its name from the variable foo), but doesn't say whether they stop the key being a variable expression for static analysis (native/analysis/traversal-parenthesized-map-key), which would read (a) as the keyword a. hashicorp/hcl marks a key that starts with a parenthesis ForceNonLiteral (parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go), so ObjectConsKeyExpr.AsTraversal (hclsyntax/expression.go) gives no traversal and getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reports that the key isn't an attribute name.
reference_error: Object constructor map keys must be attribute names
